name: pi-claude-code-ui
description: Claude Code-style grouped tool rows for pi with Ctrl+O/Ctrl+Shift+O previews, math rendering, and consistent built-in, MCP, and custom tool rendering
author: FammasMaz

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:source && npm run typecheck:renderers
scripts.typecheck:source: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck extensions/index.ts extensions/spinner.ts scripts/test-generic-errors.ts
scripts.typecheck:renderers: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck scripts/renderer-test-harness.ts scripts/test-click-e2e.ts scripts/test-mcp-renderer.ts scripts/test-renderer-integration.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:generic-errors && npm run test:renderers
scripts.test:renderers: npm run test:mcp-renderer && npm run test:renderer-integration
